programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Pawn Stars reality show is about every day routine at Gold & Silver Pawn Shop based in Las Vegas, Nevada. It is a family business, three generations of Harrison family are buying and then selling unique objects that are of considerable historical, artistic or other cultural value. The main purpose is to make a profit which means separate the wheat from the chaff, have a keen scent for one-of-a-kind authentic items and recognize fake stuff as well as appraise items value flawlessly. It is absolutely breath-taking to watch the Harrisons run their shop, it is a mixture of psychological skills and business activity. Who would have thought that this ordinary, at first glance, job could be so jaw-droppingly fascinating.

programme.title: Secrets Declassified with David Duchovny
programme.desc: Wars are won by men but fought with weapons—and nothing was left to chance. Declassified files reveal secret programs, from a Soviet super-bomb to a CIA toxin gun, and even a bizarre plan to feminize Hitler.

programme.title: Holy Marvels with Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: Archaeologists have spent centuries searching for the legendary locations of holy births, deaths, miracles, and wars. In this episode, we explore the stories behind these lost sacred sites and the incredible endeavours to find them.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: The Great Pyramid of Giza remains as one of the biggest mysteries of the world, with evidence suggesting it may have been an ancient power plant. Could these structures hold the key to unraveling the truth about humanity's extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
programme.desc: Rivaling the famous Area 51 in Nevada for UFO sightings and paramormal activity, is the lesser known, but equally fascinating, Uinta Basin in Utah and, in particular, Skinwalker Ranch. For the first time, a team of scientists and experts have been granted unlimited access to the infamous and secretive 512-acre property in order to unlock the mysteries of more than 200 years of UFO activity, bizarre animal mutations and preternatural phenomena. Making good use of state-of-the-art tecnology such as drone thermography, ground-penetrating radar and lasers, the team apply their knowledge and expertise to make shocking discoveries.

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: The Curse of Oak Island is an active reality television series that focuses on the Oak Island mystery. There are numerous mystical stories of buried treasure and unexplained objects on or near this enigmatic island in Nova Scotia. Since the 19th century several attempts have been taken to locate treasure and artifacts there, some people even lost their lives trying to read this riddle. The Lagina brothers, Rick and Marty, were so impressed by this legend that they decided to try their luck and start this dangerous mission with the help of modern technologies and machinery. They are hammering at finding whatever is there, hidden deep under the ground, taking no notice of the fact that so far not even one research has ended up successfully.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: Non-fiction series explores all kinds of mysterious things and objects, hosted by William Shanter. William draws viewers' attention to numerous enigmatic things in our life- unexplainable events, bizarre rituals, strange creatures, things of the mind, evil places. There are stories about deadly forests and mountains from where people do not return, voodoo and exorcism, premonitions that come true, and host's favorite story about a man who starts to play the piano like a concert pianist after emergence from coma.

programme.title: Built to Survive

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: Legendary polar bear tracker and veteran polar bear guide Dennis Compayre presents his exclusive documentary. Have a look at the world of a polar bear mom and her newborn cubs as they leave their den for the first time, and how mother teaches her babies to survive. Spring birthing season is considered the most dangerous for humans to observe bears. That is why it has been largely undocumented until now.

programme.title: Return of the Predators
programme.desc: After 30 years of war and destruction, Gorongosa National Park in Mozambique has undergone a remarkable restoration. Herbivores once again bound across the plains, but hunters have been slower to return, leaving the park out of balance...until now!

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

Harvey Beaks
programme.desc: Welcome to the peck-uliar world of Harvey Beak, a moderately mellow young bird who flies around his magical forest home of Littlebark Grove, with best-bird friends Fee and Foo, a pair of boisterous twins. With many other animals living in the forest, there's plenty of new characters and creatures for the trio to meet, often involving them on their mischievous escapades. Harvey lives with his parents, Irving Beaks and Miriam Beaks.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! is about the adventures of Wally Trollman and his pet dragon, Norville. Wally has a magic stick that makes words come to life; each story has a new set of magic words, and Wally uses these words to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Commissioner flips his lid, literally. His toupee blows off and sticks to Maurice, who also gets red cheeks and a skinned tail, all by accident. Julien and Mort chase him with sticks, intent on beating the "monster" stuck to Maurice's head. The baboon ladies take Maurice in, protecting and pampering him because they mistakenly think he's a male baboon. It's up to the penguins to get the toupee back and restore it to its rightful scalp. // Shelly the ostrich gets stuck in drying cement and only Rico can save her. Shelly falls for him hard as a result, however, Rico's heart forever belongs to his doll. Shelly swipes the doll and tries hard to win his heart, but Rico doesn't budge and his doll is accidently hauled off in a recycle truck. The penguins give chase but are left hopelessly in the dust. Shelly, wanting to make amends, tosses them on her back and sprints after the truck - can she possibly catch it?

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "HALF-HOUR SUMMER VACATION SPECIAL The penguin's worst nightmare has come true. After a sailing trip gone wrong they wind up in the Hoboken Zoo. Strangely, the animals are happy, the zoo is a paradise, and life couldn't be better! Zookeeper Frances takes outstanding care of all of them or does she? Something sinister bubbles under the surface the happy animals are actually androids, and the real animals are held captive in a dungeon. They're too messy and Zookeeper Frances can't stand a mess! A rescue comes from a very unlikely source, and the final battle could go either way!".

programme.desc: Henry Hart is a normal eighth grade student, with an out of school job that takes him on amazing adventures. programme.title: Kamp Koral

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. Not to spoil and pamper - but to fight each other over shiny baubles! The rest of the penguins and lemurs attempt a rescue but are captured themselves and made to perform in a painful "circus" the twins put together. The tables are going to need to be turned to get this circus out of town. Byte-Sized: Kowalski has another breakthrough invention, tiny robots that group together and not only fix broken tools and appliances, but run them as well. The penguins can just sit back and let the "Nanites" take care of all their chores! The problem is, the Nanites are programmed to protect the penguins at all costs, and ultimately seal the birds inside their lair. The only way to escape is to do battle with a giant, nasty, Nanite robot.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. David "Dave" sometimes loses his temper and then he is shouting "Alvinnnnn!!!". Music is an obligatory pleasant part of every episode. Every episode touches up-to-date issues of both adults and kids from modern life like real problems at school, dating and so on. Thanks to their own foolishness chipmunks often find themselves in ridiculous situations and have to use their creativity to get out of a mess, that provides us with a good opportunity to enjoy their joyful adventures.

programme.title: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles

When trouble oozes into the streets of New York City, the team finds themselves up against Mechazoids, street gangs, and even the storm of the century! programme.title: The Twisted Timeline of Sammy and Raj
programme.desc: Everyone in town is shimmying to the latest Bollywood dance trend: The Tavish Twist! Raj loves it, but Sammy is not so keen.// When Dada's manuscript goes missing, it's up to Sammy, Raj and Tara to find out "who dun it?".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: Best & Bester
programme.desc: Best and Bester go on an undercover mission to find out why items of laundry are going missing at the Dry Cleaners. // In an unfortunate case of mistaken identity, Best has been mistaken for the notorious jewel thief, Jimmy Muggins.

programme.title: La Liga. Madrido „Getafe“ - Ovjedo „Real“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Anglijos futbolo lygos čempionatas. Čarltono „Athletic“ - Londono „Millwall“
programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: Prancūzijos "Ligue 1" futbolo lyga. Osero AJ - Monako AS
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Bundeslyga. „Heidenheim“ - Dortmundo „Borussia"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

Slim, una scatola logora, e la bottiglia ammaccata Bubbles accompagnano il piccolo Spark, una batteria usata, alla ricerca della Piramide magica: il luogo dove tutti i rifiuti possono avere una seconda chance.

programme.title: Tappo - Cucciolo in un mare di guai
programme.desc: Divertente film d’animazione di Kevin Johnson. Alla morte della padrona, il viziato cagnolino Tappo si ritrova da solo come un randagio, ma la nuova amica Zoe è pronta ad aiutarlo.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Scarpette rosse e i 7 nani
programme.desc: La fiaba di Biancaneve in una grottesca rivisitazione animata da Jin Kim. Per rompere la magia che li ha tramutati in nani, sette principi devono farsi baciare da una principessa.

programme.title: Cicogne in missione
programme.desc: Pellicola d'animazione dai creatori di "The Lego Movie". Le cicogne consegnano ormai i bebe' online, ma un imprevisto obbliga il loro miglior corriere a una corsa contro il tempo.

programme.title: Lassie torna a casa
programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire - Mammo per sempre
programme.desc: Uno dei personaggi piu' riusciti del grande Robin Williams, che scatena la sua comicita' in abiti femminili. Per stare vicino ai suoi tre figli dei quali ha perso l'affidamento dopo il divorzio, Daniel si traveste da governante e si fa assumere dall'ex moglie, interpretata dal premio Oscar Sally Field, che gli impedisce di vederli. Irriconoscibile, diventa cosi' Mrs. Doubtfire e puo' occuparsi dei tre ragazzi che si affezionano a 'lei'. Oscar per il miglior trucco. Dal regista di "Mamma ho perso l'aereo", nel cast anche Pierce Brosnan.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - L'avventura continua
programme.desc: Secondo film tratto dai romanzi di Cecile Aubry. Sebastien non crede alla morte di Angelina e parte alla sua ricerca insieme a Belle. Durante il viaggio, una scoperta cambiera' la sua vita.

programme.title: Caterina va in città
programme.desc: Commedia di Paolo Virzì con Margherita Buy e Sergio Castellitto. Giunta a Roma dalla provincia con i genitori, una timida tredicenne s'immerge nelle contraddizioni sociali della capitale.

programme.title: Come far litigare mamma e papà
programme.desc: Brillante commedia per tutta la famiglia con Giampaolo Morelli e Carolina Crescentini. Invidioso dei compagni di classe, Gabriele elabora un piano per far separare i suoi genitori.

programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan e Jack Black nel sequel campione d’incassi del film con Robin Williams. Quattro liceali trovano una console e vengono catapultati all'interno di un videogame.

programme.desc: Natalie Portman in un fanta-action tratto dalla graphic novel di Alan Moore e David Lloyd. Un giustiziere mascherato si oppone al governo totalitario che ha soggiogato il Regno Unito.

programme.title: Shadows
programme.desc: Carlo Lavagna dirige un thriller ambientato nel buio dei boschi. Una madre severa costringe le figlie a vivere da recluse in un hotel abbandonato per proteggerle da una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: La finestra sul cortile
programme.desc: James Stewart e Grace Kelly nel thriller voyeuristico di Alfred Hitchcock. Un fotoreporter costretto all’immobilità spia i vicini del palazzo di fronte e diventa il testimone di un delitto.

programme.title: Nella morsa del ragno
programme.desc: Morgan Freeman in un thriller di Lee Tamahori. Un esperto criminologo e una giovane agente indagano sul rapimento della figlia di un senatore, giungendo a una scioccante verita'.

programme.title: Here After - L'aldila'
programme.desc: Thriller horror che si interroga sulla vita oltre la morte. Dopo l'esperienza di pre-morte della figlia, una madre si convince che la ragazza abbia portato con se' qualcosa di malvagio.

programme.desc: Dario Argento torna alla regia di un horror con Ilenia Pastorelli e Asia Argento. In una Roma immersa nelle tenebre, una escort non vedente finisce nel mirino di un serial killer.

programme.title: Countdown
programme.desc: Un implacabile conto alla rovescia scandisce un thriller con Elizabeth Lail. Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. Lo scetticismo e il pensiero razionale non sembrano arginare il suo terrore perché chiunque altro abbia scaricato la stessa app muore nel momento indicato sul display. Quale mistero soprannaturale si nasconde dietro questo macabro fenomeno? Ed è possibile cambiare il proprio destino? Quinn ha poco tempo per cercare la risposta.

programme.title: Ai confini del male
programme.desc: Edoardo Pesce e Massimo Popolizio nel thriller Sky Original di Vincenzo Alfieri. Due ragazzi scomparsi dopo un rave, un paese terrorizzato. I carabinieri Meda e Rio sono chiamati a indagare.

programme.desc: Durante un uragano, Haley ignora gli ordini di evacuazione per cercare il padre scomparso. Dopo averlo trovato gravemente ferito nella casa di famiglia, i due rimangono intrappolati dalle acque e da un branco di giganteschi alligatori.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original al cardiopalma con Mel Gibson. Un conduttore radiofonico riceve in diretta la chiamata di un ascoltatore anonimo che minaccia di uccidere lui e la sua famiglia.

programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con Casey Affleck, Sam Claflin e Michelle Monaghan. Il suicidio di una paziente compromette l'equilibrio familiare di uno psichiatra.

programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia horror di Ti West con Mia Goth. 1985: Maxine Minx è un'attrice hard che sogna di sfondare a Hollywood. Il ruolo in un ambizioso film horror può essere la svolta, ma una figura misteriosa emerge dal suo passato, mentre un serial killer insanguina la città.

programme.desc: I registi insieme ai protagonisti del BarLume danno voce a un divertente racconto del dietro le quinte delle nuove storie de "I delitti del BarLume".

programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapisce la figlia dodicenne di un misterioso riccastro. La ragazzina si rivela essere una feroce vampira, pronta a difendersi con le unghie e soprattutto con i denti dai suoi malcapitati aguzzini.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al film precursore del genere catastrofico con Paul Newman e Steve McQueen. L'inaugurazione di un grattacielo a San Francisco rischia di trasformarsi in tragedia.

programme.desc: La storia vera del criminale James 'Whitey' Bulger con Johnny Depp e Benedict Cumberbatch. Anni '70: un gangster irlandese collabora con l'Fbi per incastrare i rivali della mafia italiana.

programme.desc: Palpitante thriller con Adrien Brody. Un giornalista newyorkese sprofonda in un vortice di pericoli mortali quando un'attraente sconosciuta lo convince ad indagare sull'omicidio del marito.

programme.title: Detective Marlowe
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original di Neil Jordan con Liam Neeson, Diane Kruger e Jessica Lange. Hollywood, anni 30: il detective Marlowe e' incaricato di ritrovare l'ex amante di un'ereditiera.

programme.desc: Thriller con Anthony Hopkins e Ryan Gosling. Un uomo si auto-accusa dell'omicidio della moglie, che lo tradiva con un poliziotto. Ma il suo è un piano diabolico...

programme.desc: Jason Robards e Forest Whitaker in un serrato thriller politico TV. Stati Uniti: un colonnello deve impedire un golpe organizzato da un insospettabile e pluridecorato generale.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.title: Vetro
programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: Smile 2
programme.desc: Parker Finn dirige Naomi Scott nel perturbante secondo capitolo della saga horror. Una giovane popstar, perseguitata da esasperanti allucinazioni e divorata dalla paura, deve trovare una via di fuga da una terrificante entità maligna con il potere di spostarsi di persona in persona.

programme.title: Prima ti sposo, poi ti rovino
programme.desc: George Clooney e Catherine Zeta-Jones in un'esplosiva commedia romantica dei fratelli Coen. Una donna, che colleziona mariti per denaro, si vendica sposando l'avvocato che l'ha incastrata.

programme.title: Pane e burlesque
programme.desc: Laura Chiatti e Sabrina Impacciatore in una piccante commedia a tinte rosa. Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Mamma mia! - Ci risiamo
programme.desc: Tornano Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep e Colin Firth nel sequel del musical scandito dalle canzoni degli Abba. Sull'isola greca di Kalokairi, Sophie e' alle prese con la ristrutturazione dell'hotel di famiglia e soffre per la mancanza di Sky, partito per uno stage di sei settimane negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.title: A mano disarmata
programme.desc: Claudia Gerini nel biopic sulla giornalista Federica Angeli. La cronista de 'La Repubblica' indaga sulla criminalita' organizzata di Ostia. Le ritorsioni non tarderanno ad arrivare.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.desc: Dalla regista di 'American Psycho', la biografia della nota pin up degli anni 50. Arrivata a New York con il sogno di fare l'attrice, Bettie (Gretchen Mol, interprete di "Boardwalk Empire") diventera' la prima famosa modella di bondage e l'icona della liberta' sessuale in un'America attratta dal proibito: per tutti, "The Pin-Up Queen of the Universe". Finira' per esser chiamata come testimone davanti al Senato degli Stati Uniti nell'inchiesta sugli effetti della visione di materiale pornografico sugli adolescenti americani.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves
programme.desc: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 1 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Target Center. Chris Finch's T-Wolves enjoy homecourt to start just their third-ever conference semifinal, a round Steph Curry and Golden State have reached for the eighth time in 11 years. Former Minnesota guard Jimmy Butler (2017-19) adds experience to the Warrior lineup that went seven games in Round 1, while the T-Wolves dispatched the Lakers in five.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors in Game 3 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Chase Center. With the series tied 1-1, Anthony Edwards and the T-Wolves hit the road, where they are an impressive 8-3 in the postseason since last spring. Golden State was hamstrung by Steph Curry's absence in Game 2, falling 117-93, with 20 turnovers. Julius Randle's 24 points led Minnesota.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Golden State Warriors in Game 4 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Chase Center. The T-Wolves have a 2-1 series edge and are a remarkable 9-3 on the road in the last two postseasons, after surging late in Game 3 in San Francisco for a 102-97 win. Julius Randle logged a triple double, while Anthony Edwards scored a game-high 36.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves
programme.desc: Golden State Warriors at Minnesota Timberwolves in Game 5 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Target Center. Anthony Edwards and the T-Wolves are up 3-1 on Golden State, who've lost three in a row for the first time since December as Steph Curry sits with a hamstring injury. Julius Randle joined Edwards with 30-plus points in Game 4, the first T-Wolves playoff duo to do that since 2004 (Kevin Garnett and Sam Cassell).

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Indy raced to a 1-0 series lead with a 117-98 win three days ago, fueled by Pascal Siakam's 25 points. Giannis Antetokounmpo (36 points) was just 8-for-15 on free throws for Milwaukee, which led the league in three-point percentage but was 9-for-37 in Game 1.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Fiserv Forum. Doc Rivers' Bucks have work to do down 2-0 in this rematch from last year's first round, with six of the eight total meetings between the teams decided by double-digits. Indy never trailed in a 123-115 Game 2 win, sinking all 19 of its free throws as both sides shot well throughout.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Indiana is a win away from its second straight first-round dispatching of the Bucks after scorching the nets with 60.2 percent shooting in a 129-103 Game 4 triumph. Myles Turner had 23 points (and four blocks) to lead eight double-figure scorers for the Pacers, who sank 18 threes.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 1 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. The top-seeded Thunder return to action after eight off days, facing interim coach David Adelman's Nuggets, who are fresh off winning a seven-game slugfest vs. the Clippers. MVP candidates Nikola Jokic and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander star in the teams first playoff meeting since 2011, when OKC got its first postseason series win since moving from Seattle.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 3 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. The series is knotted at 1-1 as top-seeded OKC rolls into the Mile High City for the first time since early November, following a resounding 149-106 win in Game 2. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander tallied 34 points in just 30 minutes, with his team scoring an NBA playoff record 87 first-half points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 4 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. A battle-tested Nuggets squad won Game 3 in overtime to take a 2-1 series lead on green, top-seeded OKC. Jamal Murray (27 pts., 4 steals) and Aaron Gordon sparked Denver while big man Nikola Jokic struggled (0-for-10 on threes, 8 turnovers). Jalen Williams' 32 points paced the Thunder.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 5 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Mark Daigneault's Thunder return home tied 2-2 as they've disrupted Denver big man Nikola Jokic into more turnovers (23) than assists (22) through four games. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had nine of his 25 points late in a 92-87 Game 4 win, in which OKC also had a 35-8 edge in bench scoring.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. The Pistons try again to end their 15-game playoff losing streak after falling 123-112 in Game 1 in the Big Apple, crumbling by 40-21 in the fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson's 34 led New York, while Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby combined for nine steals, four blocks and 46 points.

Bickerstaff's Pistons return to the Motor City as playoff winners for the first time in 17 years following a 100-94 triumph in Game 2 that knotted the series at 1-1. Cade Cunningham piled up 33 points and 12 boards in the win, while Jalen Brunson's 37 went for naught.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. Jalen Brunson (32 points, 11 assists) and Karl-Anthony Towns (27 points) led the way in Game 4, which also saw a last-second non-call go New York's way on a three-point shot by Tim Hardaway Jr.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: After Crispin Biscuits changes the Baby Love economy to reward companies for bringing in baby hate, Boss Baby is forced to make himself the most hated baby in town to save their startup company. programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib
programme.desc: With his identity as a fugitive businessman exposed, Boss Baby has been hiding out in the lawless land of Canada. programme.title: \t Abominable and The Invisible City

programme.title: CSI S5 E20 - Hollywood Brass
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

programme.title: Clash Of The Titans
programme.desc: In CLASH OF THE TITANS, the ultimate struggle for power pits men against kings and kings against gods. But the war between the gods themselves could destroy the world. Sam Worthington (Terminator Salvation, Avatar) stars as the Greek hero Perseus in this spectacular retelling of the classic myth (and '80s cult classic film). Born of a god, but raised as a man, Perseus is helpless to save his family from the clutches of Hades (Oscar nominee Ralph Fiennes -- Harry Potter films), the vengeful god of the underworld. With nothing left to lose, he volunteers to lead a dangerous mission to defeat Hades before he can seize power from Zeus (Oscar nominee Liam Neeson -- Batman Begins) and unleash hell on earth. With a daring band of warriors, Perseus sets off on a perilous journey deep into forbidden worlds. Battling unholy demons and fearsome beasts, he will triumph only if he can accept his power as a god, defy his fate and create his own destiny.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya is suspended from school, so he hangs out in his room all day thinking about Nagisa; in an attempt to make him feel better, Kyou and Ryou take him to the arcade.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Graduation has arrived and everyone is discussing their plans.

programme.desc: Tomoya tries to get Akio to consent to his marrying Nagisa but Akio says he'll talk only after Tomoya gets a hit in a ball game.

programme.desc: Morning sickness is keeping Nagisa bedridden; Sanae introduces her to a midwife, Yagi; Sanae confides to Tomoya her worries that having a child will be very hard for Nagisa, perhaps even hazardous.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Sitting on the knoll, Tomoya calls out to Nagisa, who emerges and transports him back through time to see what their life could have been.

programme.desc: Tomoya tells his daughter the tale of his life with Nagisa and how Ushio was born, but with a happier conclusion.
